title: Children of autosomal recessive hereditary disorder with includeDefinition
exercises: includeDefinition=true on a subtree where most concepts have SNOMED text definitions
why: Fast: one definition read per row (about 1,000 of the 1,079 children have one).
stresses: ~1,080 rows x 1 definition text (often several hundred characters)

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org returns no definitions with includeDefinition=true; SNOMED CT International 20250201 has 8,252 active text definitions, most of this subtree among them.
